# BanglaHQ

> Bangladesh's official bilingual business directory — discover verified companies, startups, and service providers across all 64 districts in Bengali and English.

BanglaHQ is the definitive digital front door for Bangladesh's businesses. We combine verified business profiles, category and district browsing, startup discovery, and B2B connections in one national platform.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Search and discover verified Bangladeshi businesses.
- [Business Directory](/directory): Browse businesses by category, division, and district.
- [Startups](/startups): Emerging Bangladeshi startups in tech, fintech, AI, and more.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free, Pro, and Verified plans for business profiles.
- [Business Tools](/tools): Made-in-Bangladesh SaaS and global tools for operators.
- [About](/about): The BanglaHQ mission and the StartBD ecosystem.

## Optional

- [Add Your Business](/onboarding): Create a free listing.
